_comment: Example only. Where an Indian broker's MCP server goes in Claude Desktop (Settings > Developer > Edit Config).
This pack does not need any broker: with "paper": true it uses its own paper broker (paper.py).
Example server: Zerodha's official hosted Kite MCP at https://mcp.kite.trade/mcp (you log in to Kite in your browser; no keys go in this file or in the chat).
You can also add the same URL as a custom connector (Customize > Connectors) instead of this file.
After adding it, set every tool that places, modifies or cancels an order, or reads your account, to Needs approval. Never Always allow.
Upstox, Dhan and other brokers publish their own MCP servers or APIs; check their docs. Never paste API keys, passwords or TOTP codes into the chat.
